_comment: PadChest (BIMCV) — 160,861 chest X-rays from Hospital San Juan, Alicante, Spain. Labels (193 findings) are NLP-derived from Spanish radiology reports plus manual review. Stored as Python-style string lists in the Labels column; harmonizer parses and one-hot encodes. Spanish reports are included via output_report. Images are PNG, distributed across 52 sibling subdirs (0..50 and 54; 51/52/53 don't exist).

primary_csv._comment: Single CSV with one row per image. ImageID is the PNG filename; ImageDir (integer 0..50, 54) is the parent subdir under base_image_dir.

patient_id._comment: Direct column in the CSV — anonymized long hash IDs.

study_id._comment: Direct column in the CSV — long hash IDs.

image_path._comment: Constructed as f'{ImageDir}/{ImageID}'. ImageDir is stored as int in the CSV, must be cast to str. Structural exception: 52 sibling image directories live INSIDE base_image_dir, so image_path carries the subdir name (same pattern as ChestX-ray14). Result resolves like 'images/0/<hash>_<slug>.png'.

labels._comment: Labels column stores a Python literal string list per row, e.g. "['cardiomegaly', 'pleural effusion']". Harmonizer parses with ast.literal_eval, strips whitespace, and one-hot encodes against the 193-label vocabulary below. Some labels in the raw CSV have leading-space variants; stripping merges them. 103 rows have NaN labels — dropped via uncertain_handling.
columns: central venous catheter via jugular vein
central venous catheter via subclavian vein
central venous catheter via umbilical vein

separate_csv._comment: Labels are in the primary CSV.

uncertain_handling._comment: NLP-derived multi-label, no per-label uncertainty marker (unlike CheXpert's -1). NaN Labels rows (103 of 160,861) are always dropped. Image-level uncertainty is expressed via two meta-labels — 'exclude' (1,312 rows) and 'suboptimal_study' (1,839 rows, ~3,151 combined). With the harmonizer's default drop_uncertain=True these rows are also dropped, leaving 157,607 rows; pass drop_uncertain=False to keep the full noisy distribution (160,758 rows).

view_position._comment: Use the cleaned Projection column (PA / L / AP / AP_horizontal / COSTAL) rather than ViewPosition_DICOM (POSTEROANTERIOR / LATERAL / ...). Projection is closer to what other CXR harmonizers expose (PA / AP / L) and is fully populated.

bboxes._comment: Localizations column contains anatomic region strings ('loc basal', 'loc cardiac', ...), NOT pixel-coordinate bounding boxes. Not exposed as bboxes.

reports._comment: Spanish radiology reports in the Report column, pre-processed (stemmed/lemmatized by the PadChest authors). 116 NaN rows. Exposed via output_report. Note: language is Spanish — not interchangeable with English-report datasets like MIMIC-CXR.

separate_csv._comment: Reports are in the primary CSV.

extra_init_params._comment: None — single CSV covers all metadata, labels, view, and reports.

custom_preprocessing: Labels column stores a string-encoded Python list per row; harmonizer parses with ast.literal_eval, strips per-label whitespace (some labels have leading-space variants in the raw CSV), and one-hot encodes against the 193-label vocabulary. ImageDir is stored as int in the CSV and must be cast to str when building image_path. 103 rows with NaN Labels are dropped.
